Fixed the regression in boltons/urlutils.py's URL.get_authority() method. The bug was an inverted condition: `if not (self.password):` was used instead of `if self.password:` when deciding whether to add the ':password' part after the username in the authority string. This caused the password to be incorrectly omitted when present (or spuriously added when absent/empty), breaking roundtrip serialization, userinfo rendering, and quoted-userinfo rendering.
